basic_info.description: This impeccable mid-century home offers 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom, a large bonus room and bath and breathtaking views. Set on an extra-deep lot in the Noe Valley hills, the home enjoys panoramic outlooks from Twin Peaks and the San Francisco skyline. Features include front and rear landscaped gardens, wide plank engineered wood floors, dual pane windows, custom lighting and nest thermostat. The main level features a spacious living room with a handsome wood-burning fireplace and a spacious dining area adjacent to a newly remodeled kitchen featuring new quartz counters, custom cabinets, tile backsplash, stainless gas range, hood, dishwasher and 4-door refrigerator. 2 well appointed bedrooms both with city views, and a full bathroom with tub and shower. Downstairs, an additional room and full bath provide flexible space for guests, office, or media. The deep landscaped walk-out rear garden, also with great views, includes a generous lawn, terraced beds, and mature fruit trees-perfect for entertaining or relaxing. Highlights include a one-car garage, laundry, and abundant storage. Close to shopping, dining, cafes and entertainment, access to public transit and freeways. Children and dog lovers and outdoor enthusiasts enjoy many outdoor areas, parks and dog parks
